title: BOX OF CABINET PLATES
reason: Seven cabinet plates with Paragon, Royal Doulton and Maling marks plus a hand-painted Aesthetic Movement style plate whose maker is not shown; generic title, so possibly under-described.
findings: Seven cabinet plates. Three backstamps photographed: (a) PARAGON FINE BONE CHINA with royal arms and 'By Appointment China Potters to Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth, Made in England, Regd', orange painted number reads about 2943 (mid-20th century Paragon mark); (b) ROYAL DOULTON lion-on-crown mark with 'Made in England', pattern number D 5856 and a letter C, on a cream earthenware glaze, so probably the multicolour anemone chintz plate but that is not proven; (c) MALING castle mark with 'Newcastle-on-Tyne England' on a crazed white glaze. The plates: a mint green and gilt plate with a floral spray centre; a multicolour anemone chintz plate with a black and white lattice rim and a wire hanger; a cobalt blue plate with three gilt Chinese dragons round a central rosette (maker not shown, could be Maling, Doulton or another); three gilt-bordered plates with rose or posy centres (peach and cream grounds, one with a cobalt band); and a hand-painted Aesthetic Movement style plate with a moulded pink bead rim, gilt scroll cartouches and cherry blossom with a butterfly, a moth and flies, which looks about 1880s and is the most interesting piece. Backs of the dragon, pink bead and three gilt plates were not photographed, so their makers are unconfirmed. The title names no makers. No web price check was possible, so strength is from general knowledge.
condition: Pink bead plate has a tiny dark flaw on the pink rim at about 3 o'clock (possible small chip or speck); gilt mostly intact. Other plates show only light gilt rubbing in the photos; no cracks or large chips seen, but rims and backs were not all photographed. Maling glaze is crazed (normal for earthenware).
rescore_note: Seven cabinet plates. Paragon, Doulton and Maling marks are common mid-range pieces, the pink bead Aesthetic plate and the dragon plate are the best but their makers are unconfirmed, so the $80 to $200 band. General knowledge, no web check.
